Tableau Viz Extensions

7 extensions · Tableau 2024.2+ (Desktop, Server, Cloud)

Bar List v1.3.4

Ranked bars for a dimension: value and % of total, Top N + Others, several KPIs with switch buttons (incl. calculated ones), drill-down from Category to Sub-Category (up to 4 levels), optional breakdown and target, thin to thick and square to round bars.

Download .trex Live preview (sample data)

Funnel v1.2.0

Conversion funnel from the measures on the Stages shelf (e.g. Started → Submitted → Approved → Disbursed): one box per stage with % of start and % of previous stage, the drop between stages, overall conversion and the weakest step.

Download .trex Live preview (sample data)

KPI Card v1.8.7

A row of KPI cards from a plain date and your measures: MTD, last month or last day as the big number, worked out in the extension. Calculated KPIs (e.g. Average Loan Size = Loan Amount / Loans) are rolled up correctly for each period. Comparison, secondary values, target progress, and a chart per card: mini trend, daily bars + running total, bars, line or running total.

Download .trex Live preview (sample data)

Multi Measure Trend v1.0.5

Several measures over time on one chart. Each measure can be a solid, dashed or dotted line, an area or bars, with its own color and axis, plus a tooltip comparing them.

Download .trex Live preview (sample data)

Smart Table v1.4.4

Fast flat table for large data (virtual scrolling): sort and filter any column, search, conditional colors, totals, and row selection that drives dashboard actions.

Download .trex Live preview (sample data)

Smooth Trend v1.10.1

Smooth line trend with a KPI header (latest, MTD, QTD, YTD or your own calculation), growth/degrowth coloring and smart tooltips.

Download .trex Live preview (sample data)

Stage Flow v1.1.0

Where applications go: a flow through ordered stages (e.g. Responsible lending → … → Disbursed) where what leaves at each stage peels off, split by outcome (Rejected / Cancelled / In progress) with the reasons on hover; after the last stage, kept vs cancelled.

Download .trex Live preview (sample data)

How to use

  1. Download the .trex file of the extension.
  2. In a worksheet, open the mark-type dropdown on the Marks card → Viz Extensions → Add Extension → Access Local Viz Extensions and pick the file.
  3. Tableau Server / Cloud: an admin adds https://munshi4533.github.io to the allowed extensions list.
